reproduction.method: User narrowed scope to original-code reference only. Verify bound source hashes; compare reference mechanisms against target runtime wiring and simulation. No browser playtest or screenshots. Static checks do not establish player-visible acceptance.

routeReason: Concern spans core-loop state machines, progression and presentation, with no accepted root cause. This turn performs the independent QA/triage portion only; no Fixer or Builder invocation is authorized.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify target identity and reference-package hashes before using reference claims.
Record object type x lifecycle branch x presentation path x viewport before accepting hypotheses.
Report code-established differences with exact source paths, line ranges and file hashes; do not claim runtime, natural-input or perceptual verification.
Treat missing or unobserved exact branches as BLOCKED; a passing sibling cannot close them.
Separate source-proven behavior, human-locked deviations, implementation observations, and unknowns.
Return prioritized concrete gaps without declaring the failed FULL_BUILD or release complete.
